notes.title: Community Update #11: Challenges & Passages
notes.notes:
I'll tell you where the path leads us. 
But before that, let me tell you about the Challenges.

[h2]Challenges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/cfa62fbb4cd123548f3451ffaf116a4f79d5a086.gif[/img]
What’s this? A Shrine...

As you delve deeper, you will discover different rooms that have their own unique battles and loot. In one such room, you find yourself in the middle of the conflict. Perhaps it's your noise, or the creatures have set an ambush. Complete the challenge, claim your loot, and continue your descent into the depths.

So how will you notice these challenges? By looking ahead through the passage...

[h2]Passages[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/09a5e744a795c155a2d07fb2a95cc36213070c84.png[/img]
What lies ahead? What lies further down the passage?

Let's see where the road will take us, then decide what to do. Advance stronger and with a plan.
Be ready for different challenges. Play the updated Demo now!

notes.title: Community Update #10: Biomes
notes.notes:
Finally... Hello everyone,

We've just discovered a new area, and I’m finally able to share it!
With new visuals and information, let's take a look at the Biomes.

[h3]Forest (Settlements / Village)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/3f01a2c7420293a38e2eb33406fa1e31ed499608.jpg[/img]
Forest, Settlement/Village, or Outdoors...

Forest feels more peaceful and calm compared to the dungeons. 
Although we occasionally encounter Goblins, securing the place isn't too difficult.

[h3]Cave[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/fe67267f60d23a7611c04e415e3748737b2eaabd.jpg[/img]
A place near the surface where tribes like Goblins, Orcs, Trolls, etc. live.

In the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2345170/view/3704832514245499387]Enemies[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2345170/view/3891737610820934498]Bosses[/url] News, we mentioned the Cave.
For example, going beneath a structure near the Graveyard leads us to the Cave. By defeating enemies, we advance further and reach deeper levels.
We know, we are far from the Lich. However, as their numbers decrease, they get summoned.

[h3]Underworld[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/8093c8516d3f3a6ace74c4a38d635776b7716aae.gif[/img][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/10083b08ff311ca709a09a28ce56674bbd2ac22f.jpg[/img]
Wait, don’t eat! Don’t eat unknown mushrooms. They might be poisonous...

Underworld is a place of Mushrooms, Beasts, Stalactites, Stalagmites, and glowing mysterious plants.

[h3]Even Deeper[/h3]
As we approach the Lich... the depths grow darker and darker.
Skeletons, Skulls...
What secrets await us in the depths?

We’ll explore what lies further below another time (in the future).
Still, since we managed to reach the surface, we’ll be able to share updates more frequently.
Keep following us for future news.

notes.title: Community Update #9: More Upgrades
notes.notes:
Once again, [b]Rise Again[/b] is here with major changes in its upgrades...
This update offers a new experience with enhancements more suited to wizardry, familiar yet unique in their own way.
When? Right now! You can add [b]Rise Again[/b] to your wishlist and try out the updated demo!

[h2]More Upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/e0178ea0d499d6d50b2bb88d5ceaa391a038ae02.png[/img]
Reach Grimoire, Training Field and Obtain Gemstone 

[h3]Level & Experience[/h3]
Level, Experience, Upgrade Points... 
With these, you permanently increase your Character Attributes in the Training Field.
When you meet your allies, you'll obtain new Trainings that allow you to improve your attributes. Then, by spending your upgrade points, you can enhance your Attributes.
Defeat your Enemies, Gain Experience, Level Up, Spend your Upgrade Points, and become even Stronger!

[h3]Magic Core[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/963c47cb1e8ac5df0a688d4ca8c66afcf17a7d9c.gif[/img]

The Gems have become clearer and more numerous... They've reshaped into Gemstones!
Each Gemstone has its own unique properties, reacting differently depending on the Core. You choose which Core to focus on. Based on your focus, attributes like Damage Bonus will improve. However, these effects are lost in permadeath.
Choose wisely to determine the properties you want to focus on and strengthen!

[h3]Spell Level[/h3]
Aka Spell Page Level...
When you find spell pages, you'll notice that spells have levels. Just like not all recipes are the same and some details add more flavor, details in spells allow you to cast more powerful magic. Sometimes, you even discover those details as you perform or choose them.
Oh! I almost forgot. There’s a spellbook (Is it a Grimoire?) kept by the Old Mage back at the Base. 
Don’t forget to take a look!

[h3]Essay Level[/h3]
Did you know? Essays can be upgraded. How? By pondering them.
Once you've identified the Essays, it's possible to improve them.
Think deeply, and enjoy their evolution.

[h3]Destruction & Drops[/h3]
With Destruction, you can break objects in the environment.
They might drop items, which you can collect.

As always, feel free to share your thoughts. You can reach us through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2345170/discussions/]Community Hub[/url]!
Stay tuned, Add to Wishlist & Follow!

notes.title: Community Update #8: Upgrades
notes.notes:
What's going on, what's going on? [b]Rise Again[/b], rises again with major changes to upgrades...

How big are these changes, you ask? Big enough to understand the Essays in the Scholar's Orb, pull planets out of their orbits, and even introduce you to fairies!

Before we dive into the changes, let’s talk about some of your requests:
[list]
[*] 🤝 Better Synergy on Abilities
[*] 🤝 More Complex Upgrades
[*] 🤝 More Enemy Types
[/list]

Thank you for playing the demo and for sharing your feedback and suggestions. Thanks to you, we’re making improvements and adding exciting new features. So, what are these new features? Let’s take a look!

[h2]Upgrades[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/f32e86c9968393360fe781a82cddb522bfbafd97.gif[/img]

[h3]Training Field[/h3]
Placing Arcane (Rogue) Planets in an Arcane Orbit in the Cosmos to enhance their Attributes is something a Wizard can do, right? But do you know how Attributes are enhanced in [b]Rise Again[/b]?

Character Attributes improve through Training. Therefore, meet the people around you and collaborate. You'll see that they also act as your trainers and guide you in your training...


[h3]Scholar's Orb / Essays[/h3] 
The Scholar's Orb is a magical sphere containing Essays. Even if you notice some of the Essays inside, you might not be able to fully comprehend or define what they convey. Therefore, choose from the Essays you can understand. The Essay you select will grant you visions and knowledge. Afterward, the Scholar's Orb will break into pieces.

Essays provide statistical gains (increases/decreases) that are triggered under certain conditions. For example, you will gain an effect/trait that increases your damage when your health is low. These enhancements will last until the moment you die.


[h3]Fairy's Wish[/h3]
What's this, a captured fairy?
Rescue it! Once freed, the fairy will offer you its blessings. The fairy will even accompany you and assist in your battles. Fairies are skilled in magic, and with one by your side, you'll feel even more powerful.

Fairy's Wishes are passive spells triggered under certain conditions. When a fairy blesses you, it will offer you random wishes. You can choose one of the fairy's wishes, and it will remain effective until you die.


[h3]Spell Page[/h3]
Spell Pages are torn pages from spellbooks that explain how to cast spells. Spell Pages are active abilities that you can use at any time, and you cast them directly (using your controller/input key). 
In short, Fireball, Frost Nova, etc.


[h3]Consumable[/h3]
What is the [spoiler] Elixir or Scroll [/spoiler] that you’ve picked up? Do you know?  
Ask someone who knows or learn by experimenting on your own. Taste the Elixir or read the Scroll; once you see its effects, you'll be able to define it. However, since you don’t know the effects, you may not use it effectively. The choice is yours!

[h3]And More...[/h3]
New Enemy Types/Ranks (Common Enemy, Elite Enemy, Mini Boss, Boss), Chest, Resting Camp / Ration, etc.

[b]We’ve updated the Demo of Rise Again![/b]
Yes, when we updated the Upgrades, we also brought some of them to the Demo. You can play the updated demo right now.

There's more waiting for you in the full version!
Keep watching us by adding [b] Rise Again [/b] to your wishlist and following...

In this version, we will be able to advancing better progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/910eb4260d4d8144b9034ac4d7069fd65b5f3546.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Combat: Character Attributes changed from Arcane Orbit to Training Field!

notes.title: Community Update #7: Bosses
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Now we know who we'll encounter at the depths of the first dungeon, the nearest boss. I suppose he's a Troll?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/b9957c06d12c9bef79fe18747d39d2758081b80e.gif[/img]

Trolls are a bit different from those in ancient legends/mythologies. They are more agile and aggressive creatures. According to rumors, they have been raised by someone to fight and lead. The locals call them names such as Thrall'ia, Trollja, Trolljin, Tr?ull (Trûll, Tröül). Therefore, I will note them as Trolls. 
Lastly, regarding Trolls, I will talk about this Boss. He attacks with axes and a massive tooth. 
Make sure to dodge him attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/d2809faa1ba2781029264bc6adb0115a461d36c9.gif[/img]

How did we reach the Bosses? When we reached sufficient depth...
The dungeons consist of rooms/floors. In these rooms, there are enemies ready for battle. When they realize their lairs are invaded, they won't hesitate to attack. Defeat them and face their leaders!

notes.title: Community Update #6: Enemies
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[i]"Keep your friends close, but keep your enemies even closer."[/i]  So, let's get to know them.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/97daedf14760680a30033f9a76deefe9181b7e4e.gif[/img]

The first enemies we encounter are humanoid creatures similar to Goblins and Orcs. According to our observations, they live like a tribe, and there is a division of tasks among them. They form up during battles; some engage in close combat, while others cast spells from a distance. Some also stealthily lurk, waiting for your vulnerable moment. Watch your back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/313fce6f082320c9a969fd44721acf8a510ea43c.gif[/img]

Let's talk about rumors. 
People say that these creatures appeared suddenly, raiding settlements from dungeons, caves, and even graveyards. Those who ventured into those areas spoke of magical circles and summoning spells. Additionally, they mentioned more powerful/different creatures in the depths of the dungeon. It seems they are accustomed to raids and are taking their own precautions. Nevertheless, they feel trapped and are seeking a way out. For now, this is the extent of the information we have.

We will learn more in-depth and clear information over time.

notes.title: Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
Shh... shh... hush...
There might be scouts around. Approach quietly, let's take a sneak peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/ddb7e27205d398970a8837f680586c1394658cde.gif[/img]

As you can see, we encounter enemies and defeat them. We are gradually reaching the depths of the dungeons. There, they have leaders/bosses. For now, we haven't been able to go deeper, but we hope to gather more information soon.

In short, the progress continues... Let's retreat without getting caught by anyone!

Did you like it? Don't forget to follow!

notes.title: Community Update #5: Spells
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Open your spellbook and note the new spells before you forget! Perhaps there are pleasant effects of spells...

[h2]Status Effects[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/029514fc83aa12449898c2c6a1ca78ba31cca075.gif[/img]

Burn, Chill, Freeze, Knockback, Stun etc. status effects will assist you in overcoming challenges. You can throw the enemy off a cliff or instantly halt enemy attacks...

[h2]Spells[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/d6b67bce0f8de2041bdf38edc077458ff1c5ee9f.gif[/img]

Spells shape your offensive moves during battles. [b]To cast a spell, you must know.[/b] As a skilled wizard, you can cast common spells from memory. Of course, if you haven't lost your memory... 

There are various spells such as Long-range, Close-range, Directional, Non-directional, and many more. These spells can have effects ranging from single-target to Area of Effect (Sphere, Cone, Cube, etc.) effects. Also spells have different damage types such as Physical, Fire, Cold, etc. Use compatible spells and damage types to create your own synergy!

Claim your spellbook, don't let enemies loot your pages!

notes.title: Community Update #4: Gameplay
notes.notes:
G...Ga...Gameplay! Yay! 

Rewinding time, awakening without memory, finding spell pages, and defeating numerous foes are all commonplace. The inhabitants there are accustomed to these. You, too, will experience the effects of this life.

[h2]Combat[/h2]

Defeat enemies by casting spells, engaging in melee combat, and swiftly dashing through the battlefield. Beware, for they will be watching you closely!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/c28487395ca336cdb4c5c7b430bb7857c6cb9a7d.gif[/img]

[h2]Advancement[/h2]
Also known as Leveling or Character Progression...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/7f33f8187f48159a70b656cf526bceb13a3b4bf1.gif[/img]
Firebolt, Fireball and many more spells... 

Discover collectibles that grant permanent attribute enhancements, fleeting bonuses that fade upon death, and time-based or encounter-based boosts that empower your character. Use them wisely to shape your destiny in this extraordinary adventure.

Death isn't an end, but a chance to [b]rise again[/b].

notes.title: Community Update #3: Environments
notes.notes:
Hey, let's see where we've been.

We explored villages, delved into the depths of caves, fought various creatures. We died, resurrected, and rose again. And now, finally, we bring you new visuals.

[h2]Villages[/h2]

Villages are generally large areas with fewer enemies and battles in the open air. They have an open world feel due to being outdoors, but there are still certain paths to follow. These paths can lead you to the dungeon entrances.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/b3fb6769a665cf3a3bebde21f8113f7b70a1550e.png[/img]

There are various dungeon entrances in [b]Rise Again[/b]. Sometimes they take the form of a building, while other times they are caves or underground tunnels. Crossroads can take you further, or to the dungeon...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/a07741c614cd7bfd5f70bb02b10b9d8e45e52139.gif[/img]

[h2]Dungeons[/h2]

Dungeons are small rooms/maps where you can quickly defeat enemies. When you enter the creatures' lair, many will attack to hunt you down. [b]Be careful in the dungeons![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/1185d28e844a4834431a2525ba95c65fa9f5fbee.png[/img]

Some places are composed of remnants from ancient times, while some remain untouched. Therefore, dungeons can resemble stone caverns, architectural structures, flowing lava, crumbling ceilings, or ruins with magical artifacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/2eb9b1df7b0e74367ff3d7765cd767722e7644f2.png[/img]

Who knows, maybe at the end of the dungeon, you can fight the dungeon master (creature leader/boss) and win rewards...



Stay tuned for future updates as we continue to refine and expand the game world. Thank you for joining us on this journey through fantastical realms!

notes.title: Community Update #2: Key Features
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Let's take a look at the key features of [b]Rise Again[/b].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/0d73dfbba80b55db99d57761489ae1ba77199d74.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018578/0d73dfbba80b55db99d57761489ae1ba77199d74.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gameplay Combination of "Action-Roguelike" and  "Hack and Slash"
[*] Fast-paced Combat by Wizardry
[*] 3D, Realistic, Atmospheric visuals 
[*] Story set in the Medieval Fantasy Universe
[*] Keyboard / Mouse and Gamepad Support 
[*] Casual and Twin-stick shooter controller
[/list]
